# Muto Runtime

> Zero-restart Fabric 26.x JVM mod loader, live JVMTI Mixin retransformation engine, and registry thaw framework for Minecraft 26.1 - 26.3 (Java 25).

## Version & Compatibility
- Release: 0.1.0-beta+26.x
- License: Elastic License 2.0 (ELv2)
- Minecraft: 26.1 - 26.3 (26.x)
- Fabric Loader: >=0.16.0
- Fabric API: >=0.144.1
- Java: 25
- Site: https://muto.fy2ne.me
- Documentation: https://muto.fy2ne.me/docs
- Source: https://github.com/fy2ne/Muto_runtime
- Companion UI Mod: https://mutomenu.fy2ne.me

## Architecture Subsystems
1. JVMTI Instrumentation (MutoAgentBootstrap, DynamicMixinEngine, MutoClassFileTransformer): attaches Instrumentation and invokes retransformClasses() to apply or strip Mixin weaves without JVM restart.
2. ClassLoader & Windows Unlocker (KnotInjector, JarUnlocker, MutoClassLoader): mutates KnotClassLoader classpath URLs and releases URLJarFile / ZipFile descriptors on Windows before file renames.
3. Registry Thawing & DI Guards (RegistryFreezer, MappedRegistryAccessor, DiContainerGuard, ResourceHotMount): temporarily unfreezes MappedRegistry instances, cleans orphaned CustomPacketPayload codecs and KeyMappings, and mounts dynamic resources.
4. Boundary Execution (ReloadBoundaryManager, MutoReconnectingScreen, ModDependencyAnalyzer): classifies mods across Reloadable, Mixin, Stubborn, and Protected tiers, cleanly disconnecting singleplayer/multiplayer worlds before swapping and rejoining afterward.

## Public Java SDK
- me.fy2ne.muto.api.MutoApi: isAvailable(), isReloading(), isSafeToReload(), plan(), reloadAsync(), loadMod(Path), unloadMod(String), reloadWithBoundary(Screen), getReloadableModIds(), getStubbornModIds(), getHistory(), isDevMode(), runReloadSimulation()
- me.fy2ne.muto.api.MutoEvents: RELOAD_START, RELOAD_FINISH (invoked on reload worker thread)
